Shared preallocated diagnostic state is rebound on rdbuf replacement and reset on invocation; conservative separators and sticky display failure remain.

benchmarks.protocol: Fresh-process CLI export after fixture creation, to /dev/null; one warm-up and five alternating measured runs per size and build. No concurrent analyzers or tests during measurement. Exact byte counts verified by each backend. Flush counts and intercepted descriptor-write calls are distinct metrics, not a claim about all hidden libc syscalls.

validation_corrections: Question fixture requires plan mode; byte-preservation tests use binary capture to avoid Python universal-newline conversion.
Darwin public file-status flags are compared separately from internal kernel write-history bits.
Foreground resume can interrupt tcsetattr; native application now retries EINTR.
Completed journal coverage compares durable journal payloads directly; retrying a pre-normalization message is a separate contract.

One initial ASan unit run reported Child process setup failed in unchanged Followup.ObservationOwnershipLossNeverSignals. Thirty isolated repetitions and the final full suite passed; root cause was not established and the test was not changed.
New analyzer findings were resolved with initialized export storage, size_t multiplication and explicit return after suppressed serialization failure. No checks were weakened.
limitations: Clang-Tidy completes 24/25 sources and retains the same six baseline findings, including the old-SDK incomplete platform.cpp translation unit. This gate is not clean.
Clang Analyzer retains the same context.cpp core.DivideZero finding. This gate is not clean.
Semgrep uses the locked Python frontend 1.177.0; existing native frontend mismatch remains separate.
Existing local implicit-int-float-conversion and unused-result compiler warning downgrades are unchanged; no tracked checks were weakened.
Linux and native Tiger runtime acceptance were not run locally.
